content.text:
I fixed both problems in two commits on `t3/preserve-parallel-request`. `npm test`, lint and a type check pass. I haven't tested it on a live call and haven't pushed.

**What went wrong:** you said "can you also do for last month as well", and the chat agent took that as a correction like "no, I meant last month". That phrase was literally the example in its instructions. So it ran the replace step, which stopped the first request. A stopped request also came back as a server error, which is why it showed **failed** instead of **stopped**.

**Commit `ee612310` — a stopped request shows as stopped.** When a request is canceled, `app/api/chat/route.ts` now returns a 409 "canceled" response instead of a 502 error. The call already treats that as stopped, and Moneo says nothing about it.

**Commit 2 — new requests run alongside the others unless you drop one:**
- The replace step can only stop the most recent running request, never an older one.
- It isn't offered at all when your message adds to what's running: "also", "as well", "too", "at the same time", "additionally", "auch", "außerdem". The server checks for these words itself, so it doesn't rely on the model judging it.
- Otherwise it runs only when you explicitly drop the latest request: "leave that, do this instead", "no, I meant last month", "actually make it 15". In every other case, both requests run.
- I updated the voice prompt (`lib/ai/voice-call.ts`) and the replace step's description to match, and added a test for both rules.

I kept "no, I meant X" as a way to replace, since it's an explicit "leave that, do this". If you want only the "leave that" kind of wording to count, that's a one-line prompt change.
